message: Renovate proposes Cargo updates after 1 hour (minimumReleaseAge: "1 hour" in packageRules[0] of renovate.json), but cooldown.minimum in depcurfew.json is 3 days, which covers Cargo dependencies, and Cargo before 1.100.0 has no release-age delay of its own; its pull requests bring in versions younger than that
fix: Make minimumReleaseAge in packageRules[0] of renovate.json at least 3 days, or limit the rule to the packages that need a shorter delay
